items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: I saw a doctor by the name of Dr. Woodson. Killed me of it, but he told him I'd always have something.

ctx.x: I had pneumonia, typhoromalary, fever, heart liver. Ah, something else. I had all that at once when I was around 12 years old. Yeah. I saw a doctor by the name of Dr. Woodson. Killed me of it, but he told him I'd always have something. I always suffer with something. And that's where they left me with a bad stomach.
Well, when you stopped your business in Pastor Christian and came over here, who did you play with?
